title: Paper-trading draft portfolios, a separate feature from a saved draft (row 16 match line)
reference_behaviour: A Draft Mode records trades that are not real into portfolios with booked and unbooked P&L, stated plainly as not real trades. Switching underlying in that mode crashed the screen (a measured bug, not copied).
ours: REQ-109 paper tracking of one saved strategy is the nearest; no portfolio of paper trades. Our word draft means a saved, not-executed strategy, so the name is not reused.
